en.导入前会自动验证编辑器会话、账号身份与配额: Sessions, identity and quota are verified before import
en.确认删除该账号？其生成记录与产物将同时删除: Delete this account? Its receipts and media will be removed too
en.API Key 长度至少 8 位: API key must be at least 8 characters
en.密码长度至少 4 位: Password must be at least 4 characters
en.暂无账号，点击右上角接入: No accounts yet; use the button above to add one
en.浏览器扩展通过该令牌向账号池推送或刷新凭据: The browser extension pushes or refreshes credentials with this token
en.空闲会话保活（自动探活并续期 Cookie）: Idle session keepalive (probe and rotate cookies)
en.管理凭据已更新，请重新登录: Admin credentials updated; sign in again
en.粘贴新的 Cookie（JSON 数组或请求头字符串）: Paste new cookies (JSON array or header string)
en.重置后旧令牌立即失效，已配置的扩展需要更新令牌。继续？: The old token stops working immediately; update any configured extension. Continue?
en.Google 登录将在服务器端的浏览器中完成，登录后凭据自动接入账号池，失效时由: Google sign-in happens inside a browser running on the server; credentials join the pool automatically and the browser profile renews them when they expire.
en.浏览器 Profile 服务未启用: Browser profile service is not enabled
en.登录会话进行中，请在浏览器窗口完成 Google 登录: Login session in progress — finish the Google sign-in in the browser window
en.登录成功，正在接入账号池…: Sign-in complete, joining the account pool…
en.Google 账号（可选，用于全自动登录）: Google account (optional, enables fully automated login)
en.填写账号与密码后登录全程自动完成；不填写则通过远程桌面手动登录。凭据保存后用于会: With account and password filled in, the sign-in completes automatically; otherwise use the remote desktop to sign in manually. Stored credentials power automatic re-login when a session expires.
en.Google 要求人工验证，请打开远程桌面手动完成: Google asks for human verification — finish it via the remote desktop
en.正在通过 YesCaptcha 自动完成验证码…: Solving the CAPTCHA automatically via YesCaptcha…
en.验证码自动通过失败，将继续等待或需人工处理: Automatic CAPTCHA solve failed; waiting or manual help may be required
en.已配置（输入新值可更换）: Configured (enter a new value to replace)
en.自动重登仅用于已保存登录凭据的账号。关闭后仍保留会话保活与手动登录。: Automatic login requires saved account credentials. Session keepalive and manual login remain available when disabled.
en.重试仅用于免费请求与媒体下载，付费生成提交不会自动重发。: Retries apply to free requests and media downloads. Paid generation submissions are never retried automatically.
en.账号代理优先于全局代理。修改后在下次上游操作前验证并切换；测试仅检查当前输入的地: Account proxies take precedence over the global proxy. Changes are verified before the next upstream operation. The test checks only the entered address.
en.缓存时长为 0 时不自动过期。关闭缓存后，图片接口需使用 b64_json 响应: A cache lifetime of 0 disables expiry. When caching is disabled, image requests must use b64_json.
en.推送刷新成功后恢复自动封禁账号: Restore automatically disabled accounts after a successful push
en.手动停用的账号保持停用。令牌留空可保留原值。: Manually disabled accounts stay disabled. Leave the token blank to keep its current value.
en.调试日志仅记录脱敏后的结构摘要，凭据、文本内容与媒体数据始终隐藏。: Debug logs contain sanitized structure summaries. Credentials, text content and media data are always hidden.
en.登录已失效，请重新登录: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
en.服务器返回了无效配置: The server returned an invalid configuration.
en.配置数据不完整，请重新加载: Configuration data is incomplete. Reload to continue.
en.配置加载失败，请重试: Configuration could not be loaded. Please retry.
en.推送令牌须使用非空白 ASCII 字符: Push tokens must contain non-whitespace ASCII characters.
en.API Key 须使用非空白 ASCII 字符: API keys must contain non-whitespace ASCII characters.
en.访问地址须为不含认证信息、查询参数或片段的 HTTP(S) 地址: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
en.启用代理时必须填写代理地址: Enter a proxy address before enabling the proxy.
en.已选中文本，请复制: Text selected. Copy it to continue.
en.两次输入的新密码不一致: The new passwords do not match.
en.连通测试失败，请检查网络后重试: The connection test failed. Check your network and retry.
en.查看调用状态、耗时与生成结果: Inspect request status, timing and generated media
en.生成 ID、账号邮箱或编号: Generation ID, account email or number
en.请求已返回，生成结果以回执为准: Request returned; check the receipt for the outcome
en.日志加载失败，请点击刷新重试: Could not load logs. Use Refresh to retry.
en.202 表示本次请求已返回，生成结果以回执为准。请勿盲目更换幂等键重复提交。: 202 means this request has returned. Check the receipt for the generation outcome before submitting with another idempotency key.
en.点击后读取本地生成文件，不会重新提交生成请求。: Loads the saved media on request. No new generation is submitted.
en.该日志已不存在，请刷新列表: This log no longer exists. Refresh the list.
en.详情加载失败，请重试: Could not load details. Please retry.
en.生成结果尚未完成、已过期或不可用: The media is not ready, has expired or is unavailable.
en.清空失败，请重试: Could not clear logs. Please retry.
